$comment: Allowlist for scripts/check-scan-findings.mjs, the gate over the scanners that run
outside the JS test suite: Trivy image and IaC scans, and the ZAP baseline, in
The grammar is the same as scripts/semgrep-allowlist.json on purpose. A finding at
or above the job's severity floor with no entry fails CI. An entry past its expiry
fails CI even though the finding still matches, so an acceptance cannot outlive the
triage that justified it. An entry that matches nothing fails CI as stale.
"scanner" is "trivy" or "zap" and scopes the entry to one report, so a ZAP plugin
id can never excuse a Trivy CVE that happens to share its number. Omit "locations"
to accept a finding wherever it appears; each value is matched as a substring of the
finding's location, which is "<target>:<package>@<version>" for a Trivy
vulnerability, the scanned path for a misconfiguration, and the first instance URL
